fixes.explanation: Yes, baker. God says, "…its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD…" (Exodus 28:35). The robe has gold bells alternating with pomegranates around the lower hem (Exodus 28:33–34). That's a robe with its own soundtrack.

That's it, baker. God tells Moses to make a plate of pure gold and engrave on it "…as on a seal: HOLY TO THE LORD." (Exodus 28:36). Then a blue cord mounts it on the turban, right on the front (Exodus 28:37). I've had stamps that blurred on me, so a plate that says it so clearly makes me jealous.

Elders is a respectable guess, baker, but they don't show up in this verse. God says to engrave "…the names of the sons of Israel…" on the two onyx stones (Exodus 28:9). Six names go on one stone and six on the other (Exodus 28:10).

Camp is a big place to aim for, baker, but it isn't the word in the verse. God says, "…its sound will be heard when he enters or exits the sanctuary before the LORD…" (Exodus 28:35). The sound is tied to the sanctuary, where Aaron goes in and out.
